description: Adopt shared logging for the four timed-result families (#672; REQ-019, C45; G07; R43, R82, R100, R115, R116; TASK-AC-1C4999D342BC, TASK-AC-47129E192333, TASK-AC-E2222DBA54CA; foundation provider for JOURNEY-019). The four timed families' real entry points on /workout - the EMOM's end of schedule (EmomBlock), the AMRAP's closed window (AmrapBlock), For Time's finish or cap (ForTimeBlock) and the ladder's log (LadderBlock) - draw one Log results action in the shared action row where the inline TimedResultLog was, and the same log opens in the shared focused LoggingOverlay titled Log results (src/ui/refinements/timed-result-dialog.tsx over logging-overlay.tsx and timed-result-log.tsx): a native modal over an inert workout, the framed icon-only Close log X focused, the Balanced backdrop, the family's own fields only, with no Save added - the section's forward action through BlockCompletionProvider stays the one writer (block_results, then block_movement_results). check-01 proves it in the browser on a contained synthetic account: the EMOM at 390 touch (no log until the schedule ends, the counter-free notes, X and Escape keep the note, a refused save keeps it and the retry writes it once to the block's notes), the AMRAP, For Time and ladder at 320 keyboard and reduced motion (the ladder's secondary action before its attempt ends, its clock running on behind the open log, Undo finish closing the log and resuming with focus on Pause, the counts, completion correction, effort and the ladder's round-3 entry kept through Escape and reopen and through a refused save, the retry writing each row once, the saved For Time log no longer offered), and the accepted gallery states ?state=emom, amrap, for_time and ladder (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d, the route's own blocks over memory) in all four skins at 390. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-046 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-046.spec.ts --project=mobile
